description: Two copies of the pulser from the Buchla Easel. A trigger starts a timer, and a pulse comes out when the timer runs down

params.text: How much of the voltage at that section's mod input changes its period
The time the timer runs, from 2ms to 10 seconds
Starts the timer of that section by hand
Makes that section start its own timer again from its own pulse, so it runs as a repeating clock

inputs.text: A trigger starts the timer of that section
A voltage changing the period of that section

outputs.text: Sends a pulse when the timer of that section runs down
